source_clause: ICE5.) Temperature ranges: LO, 60-84, HI (English), LO, 16-28, HI (Metric). Temperature will display the current degree value the user has set it to for ATC systems, when at the Highest possible position display HI when at the lowest display LO instead of a degree value. The status is indicated on TS climate screen and in status bar. Show pop-up when status is changed via hard control and currently shown screen is not climate screen. (when sync'd, do not show slider pop-up on passenger side when adjusting driver slider). When the user sets the climate system temperature ranges to Metric the CCM switches to half degree increments . The temperature within the temp slider, status bar, temp slider popup, and temp popup will reflect this change in temperature increments .
reasoning: 驗證目標：16.6（ICE5）定出 ICS 介面之溫度值域、HI／LO 取代度數、狀態呈現位置、硬鍵 popup 條件、Metric 半度增量與其四處同步，六個 037 leaf 逐句對應，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：EMEA 軸取正向值（出處 16.2，併入 spec_ref 依 R-C29）；依 **R-C34** 第十三軸全數補（可觀察量為 HVAC 畫面與 popup），第九軸補 `-01`／`-02`／`-03`／`-05`（可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section），`-04`（popup）與 `-06`（sync 時之 slider popup）不補 —— popup 正是 6.3 之例外，第十二軸不補（ch16 無 tab 條文）；`-06` 另補第二軸（非單區，出處 16.11）。為什麼這樣切：`-01` 驗值域之兩端與單位切換、`-02` 驗端點以 HI／LO 取代度數，兩者失效形態不同（值域錯 vs 端點顯示錯），故 `-01` 取邊界值分析而 `-02` 另立。刻意略過：**鏡射表反向使用之結果** —— C5 之「This status is relayed from the CCM」一句於 ICE5 不存在，**不移植**；C5 記 Metric 切換者為「the **readout**」而 ICE5 記為「the **CCM** switches to half degree increments」，**兩者主詞不同**，本批依 ICE5 之措辭，惟 ER 停在可觀察量（畫面所示之增量）而不驗 CCM 內部行為（§8.2.1）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: ICS climate screen 之溫度顯示與 temp slider／status bar／temp popup
interface_axis_review.axis_9: `-098`／`-099`／`-100`／`-102` 暴露（可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section）→ 補；`-101`（temp popup）與 `-103`（sync 時之 slider popup）之可觀察量為 comfort popup，正是 6.3 之明文例外，不補
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— ch16 十八節無 tab 條文；2.1 屬 ch2 介面
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補。出處 2.14 C15（`For MTC with ICS … no HVAC screens and no HVAC pop ups`），跨節取據 R-C29
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不適用（反向）** —— 本節屬 ch16，取正向軸值 PC（出處 16.2，併入 spec_ref）

tcs.tc_title: Temperature range covers both English and Metric
tcs.test_item: Temperature ranges shall be LO, 60-84, HI (English) and LO, 16-28, HI (Metric)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the temperature units to English and open the climate screen
2. Adjust the temperature across its whole range
3. Set the temperature units to Metric
4. Adjust the temperature across its whole range
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the temperature setting
2. The settings available are LO, 60 to 84, HI
3. The climate screen shows the temperature setting
4. The settings available are LO, 16 to 28, HI
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)

tcs.tc_title: HI and LO replace the degree value at the extremes
tcs.test_item: When at the highest possible position the system shall display HI, and when at the lowest shall display LO, instead of a degree value
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle has an ATC climate system (16.6)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Adjust the temperature to its highest position on the climate screen
2. Adjust the temperature to its lowest position
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows HI instead of a degree value
2. The climate screen shows LO instead of a degree value
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)

tcs.tc_title: Temperature status shows on the screen and status bar
tcs.test_item: The temperature status shall be indicated on the TS climate screen and in the status bar
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen
2. Adjust the temperature on the climate screen
3. Read the status bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the current temperature
2. The climate screen shows the new temperature
3. The status bar shows the new temperature
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Temperature pop-up appears off the climate screen
tcs.test_item: The system shall show a pop-up when the status is changed via hard control and the currently shown screen is not the climate screen
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open a screen other than the climate screen
2. Change the temperature using the temperature hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen is not displayed
2. A temperature pop-up is shown
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Metric switches every temperature readout to half degrees
tcs.test_item: When the user sets the climate system temperature ranges to Metric, the temp slider, status bar, temp slider popup and temp popup shall reflect half degree increments
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the climate system temperature ranges to Metric
2. Adjust the temperature using the temp slider and read the temp slider popup
3. Read the status bar
4. Change the temperature using the temperature hard control from a screen other than the climate screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the temperature in Metric
2. The temp slider and the temp slider popup move in half degree increments
3. The status bar shows the temperature in half degree increments
4. The temp popup shows the temperature in half degree increments
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: No passenger slider pop-up while synced
tcs.test_item: When sync'd, the system shall not show the slider pop-up on the passenger side when adjusting the driver slider
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a single zone climate configuration, for which Sync is not shown (16.11)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn SYNC on from the climate screen
2. Adjust the driver temperature slider
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "SYNC" button is highlighted
2. No slider pop-up is shown on the passenger side
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
